high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "labourlawadvisor." The post features a split background with the Chinese flag on the left side and the Indian flag on the right side. Overlaid on the flags is bold text that reads, "IS INDIA BECOMING ANOTHER CHINA?" The text is in large, white and gold letters, with the question mark emphasized in gold. In the foreground, there is a photograph of a person sitting at a desk, writing in a notebook. The individual appears to be wearing traditional Indian attire, including a white kurta and a beige scarf draped over their shoulders
